company_name: National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology  Department of Electronics and Manufacturing Sensing Technology Research Institute
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company focuses on research and development in sensing technology and silicon quantum computing, which are relevant to semiconductor applications but not direct suppliers.
summary: The National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology's Department of Electronics and Manufacturing Sensing Technology Research Institute conducts research on advanced sensing technologies and silicon quantum computing. Their work aims to enhance information extraction for societal benefits and strengthen industrial competitiveness in Japan.

regional_presence.Japan: The institute is focused on enhancing industrial competitiveness and societal solutions within Japan.
